chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from a number of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from al-Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Ibn Miskan, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Five do not lead the people in prayer under any circumstance: the one afflicted with leprosy, the one afflicted with vitiligo, the insane person, the child born of zina, and the Bedouin Arab.

key_terms.الْأَبْرَصُ: a person afflicted with vitiligo or leprosy-like skin disease
key_terms.الْمَجْنُونُ: an insane person lacking sound intellect
key_terms.يَؤُمُّونَ: to lead others in congregational salat (prayer) as Imam

ai.seo_question: Who is not permitted to lead the people in congregational salat (prayer) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning those who should not serve as Imam for the people in salat (prayer). It appears in a chapter about praying behind the leprous and the one afflicted with vitiligo, and indicates categorical restriction for five types of persons in leading congregational prayer.
